candidates.label: Saying without doing named as greatly hateful in Allah's sight
candidates.definition: In 61:2-3: O you who have believed why do you say what you do not do? Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

candidates.label: Firm ranks in Allah's cause likened to a joined structure as what He loves
candidates.definition: In 61:4: Indeed Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a single structure joined firmly.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفّٗا كَأَنَّهُم بُنۡيَٰنٞ مَّرۡصُوصٞ

candidates.label: Musa's complaint of harm from his own people despite known messengership
candidates.definition: In 61:5: And when Moses said to his people O my people why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you? And when they deviated Allah caused their hearts to deviate.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تُؤۡذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعۡلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓاْ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Isa confirming Torah and naming Ahmad as the coming messenger
candidates.definition: In 61:6: And when Jesus the son of Mary said O children of Israel indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me whose name is Ahmad; but when he came to them with clear evidences they said this is obvious magic.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُم مُّصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرَۢا بِرَسُولٖ يَأۡتِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِي ٱسۡمُهُۥٓ أَحۡمَدُۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Supreme injustice named as fabrication against Allah during invitation to Islam
candidates.definition: In 61:7: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمِۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

candidates.label: Divine light perfected despite attempts to extinguish it with mouths
candidates.definition: In 61:8: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths but Allah will perfect His light although the disbelievers dislike it.

evidence.excerpt: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطۡفِـُٔواْ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The saving trade: belief and striving with wealth and lives
candidates.definition: In 61:10-11: O you who have believed shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment? It is that you believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives; that is best for you if you should know.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ تِجَٰرَةٖ تُنجِيكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

evidence.excerpt: تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡ وَأَنفُسِكُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Great attainment: forgiveness, rivered gardens and pleasant dwellings
candidates.definition: In 61:12: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence; that is the great attainment.

evidence.excerpt: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلۡكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةٗ فِي جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

candidates.label: Victory and imminent conquest as additional beloved favour
candidates.definition: In 61:13: And another favour that you love, victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

evidence.excerpt: وَأُخۡرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَاۖ نَصۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتۡحٞ قَرِيبٞۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hawariyyun pledge of support as model for the believing community
candidates.definition: In 61:14: O you who have believed be supporters of Allah as when Jesus the son of Mary said to the disciples who are my supporters for Allah? The disciples said we are supporters of Allah; and a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved; so We supported those who believed against their enemy and they became dominant.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُوٓاْ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ لِلۡحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنۡ أَنصَارِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ ٱلۡحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحۡنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٞۖ فَأَيَّدۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمۡ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ ظَٰهِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
